create.name: Susan Grau
create.bio:
Susan Grau is an evidential medium, intuitive and spiritual teacher based in Southern California. She traces her abilities to a near-death experience at the age of four, after which she says she could sense and communicate with spirit, and she has worked with clients for more than thirty years. She later completed a doctorate of divinity with Dr. Raymond Moody, the pioneer of near-death research, and she also trained as a life coach, hypnotherapist and Reiki master. Her book Infinite Life, Infinite Lessons, published by Hay House, gathers what she has learned from spirit about living, dying and what lies between.

Most of her work is one-to-one: mediumship readings that aim to bring evidence from loved ones who have died, intuitive life-path readings and spiritual coaching, offered in person and over Zoom or FaceTime. She also teaches workshops on developing the clair senses and on mediumship for students who already have some experience, gives talks on near-death experience and the afterlife, and records a regular YouTube show and podcast on spirit communication, empathy and what the dying can teach the living.
